name: C & R Roofing Services

hero.title: Texas commercial roofing
hero.lead: Leak repairs, roof replacement, coatings, restorations and new construction. With a Texas wide presence, access to the latest roof technology and a reputation for quality workmanship, C & R Roofing can install any kind of roof system.
hero.imageAlt: Two roofers working on a white single-ply membrane on a flat commercial roof

services.title: Single-Ply Roofing
services.short: TPO, PVC and EPDM membrane over insulation and deck.
services.text: Sheet membrane roofing - TPO, PVC and EPDM - installed over insulation boards and roof decks, either mechanically attached or ballasted.
services.imageAlt: A roofer in a hard hat laying membrane along the edge of a flat roof
body: Single-ply roofing systems typically are sheet membrane products over various insulation boards and roof decks. Some common single-ply roofing systems are TPO, PVC and EPDM materials, and typical installation methods include mechanically attached or ballasted.

A large portion of our commercial business at C & R Roofing Services is comprised of commercial TPO roofing. TPO formulation is based on advanced polymerization technology that combines the flexibility of ethylene-propylene rubber with the heat weldability of polypropylene, which gives a reinforced membrane with high breaking strength, tearing strength and puncture resistance.

The relatively smooth surface of the membrane produces a total surface fusion weld that creates a consistent, watertight monolithic roof assembly. Call the experts at C & R Roofing Services for all of your TPO roofing needs.
points: High breaking strength and tearing strength

services.title: Standing Seam
services.short: Metal roofs on concealed clips, with matching trim.
services.text: Standing seam metal roofing that relies on concealed metal clips attached to the structure, with the majority of the attachment hidden from view.
services.imageAlt: A dark standing seam metal roof running up to the ridge of a building
body: Standing seam roofing systems typically consist of concealed or exposed fastener systems and rely on concealed metal clips attached to the structure, with the majority of the attachment hidden from view.
Standing seam roofing systems have matching metal trim and flashings, so the edges and penetrations finish in the same metal as the roof.
points: Concealed metal clips attached to the structure
Most of the attachment hidden from view

services.title: Fully Tapered Systems
services.short: Tapered insulation that slopes a flat roof so it drains.
services.text: Tapered roof insulation systems, engineered to simulate a sloped roof structure so the water is diverted off a flat roof.
services.imageAlt: A flat roof with skylights and curb-mounted vents
body: C & R Roofing Services installs tapered roof insulation systems. You will only need fully tapered if the roof structure is flat.
C & R Roofing will construct and engineer a system that simulates the roof structure being sloped. The goal of tapered roof insulation systems is to divert the water off the roof.
points: For roof structures that are flat
Constructed and engineered to simulate a slope
Diverts the water off the roof

services.title: Retrofit Roofing
services.short: A new roofing system installed over the existing roof.
services.text: Retrofit roofing is the process of installing a new roofing system over an already existing roof, usually a single-ply system over a standing seam roof.
body: Retrofit roofing is the process of installing a new roofing system over an already existing roof. This usually involves putting a single-ply roofing system over a standing seam roof.
points: A new roofing system over an existing roof
Single-ply over a standing seam roof

services.title: Wall and Soffit Panels
services.short: Wall panels for the look of a building, soffit panels for ventilation.
services.text: Wall and soffit panels for many different buildings: wall panels mainly to make a building more appealing, soffit panels for ventilation or for aesthetics.
services.imageAlt: Vertical metal wall panels on a building against a blue sky
body: C & R Roofing Services has put on wall and soffit panels for many different buildings. The purpose of wall panels is mainly for making your building a little more appealing.
Soffit panels can be used for ventilation purposes or for aesthetics.
points: Wall panels on any kind of building

services.title: Balcony Systems
services.short: Balcony roofs and decks, down to the small ones.
services.text: Small balconies and roofs, whether the existing one is damaged or you want something new and more durable.
body: C & R Roofing Services has done small balconies and roofs. Either the roof is damaged or the client wants something new and more durable.
There is no roof too big, or in this case too small, that C & R Roofing Services can't do.

services.title: Paver Systems
services.short: Heavy duty pavers you can walk on, in many styles.
services.text: Pavers that are aesthetically pleasing while serving the purpose of walking on them, in many different types depending on the look you want.
services.imageAlt: A wide terrace paved with pavers, a timber bench across the front of it
body: C & R Roofing Services are very experienced with pavers. Pavers are aesthetically pleasing, while serving the purpose of walking on them.
They're heavy duty and durable, and there are many different types of pavers depending on what kind of look the client wants.

services.title: Shingle Roofing
services.short: Asphalt shingle roofs for homes and other buildings.
services.text: Shingle roofing is the assembly typically used for residential buildings such as homes, and asphalt shingles are cheap and reliable.
services.imageAlt: A shingle roof running up to a gable with a timber truss window
body: Shingle roofing is a roofing assembly typically used for residential buildings such as homes. This is not the case all the time, and the same assembly goes on other buildings too.
Asphalt shingles are cheap and reliable. There are different types of shingles depending on what kind of look or protection you want for your roof.
points: Different shingle types for the look you want

about.title: The roofing partner you can trust with your next project
text: With C & R Roofing as your roof construction partner, you will enjoy the confidence of knowing you are receiving the finest materials, craftsmanship and management team at the very best price.

A large portion of our commercial business is commercial TPO roofing. We recognize that you simply can't run a business or manage a building when you are concerned about faulty roofing over your products, tenants, employees or business space, so our goal is to handle any commercial or industrial roof repair in most surrounding cities.
The goal of C & R Roofing Services is to provide our customers with high-quality commercial roofing installation, repair and maintenance services that are custom designed for their unique needs.
